ETF.supersedes_wording: Older author README/scientific-ledger wording suggesting observed two one-electron reductions must be read with this correction. The original text remains immutable.
ETF.observed: PMID29283425 Results2.3 observes Mcd activity with ETF and ETF semiquinone formation.
ETF.interpretation: Introduction section#sec1-molecules-23-00068/p[2] describes a two-ETF ACAD-family mechanism with prior-work citations. It is consistent with these Mcd observations, not a directly measured Mcd 2-ETF microscopic stoichiometry. Cited prior work was not newly inspected.
ETF.formal_chemistry: The complete Rhea whole-ETF reaction, coefficients and redox-state nodes remain unchanged.

PccR.rescue_scope: Complementation restores measured propionate growth and cellular PCC activity. A rescued transcription response was not measured. Direct promoter binding and the proposed propionyl-CoA ligand remain unproven.

DRAM.corrected_scope: Four M00373 rows, three step coordinates, four RN IDs: R01859, R02765, R09979, R00833. K05606 names both methylmalonyl- and ethylmalonyl-CoA epimerase reactions, and the displayed C18026→C20238 row is the ethylmalonyl epimer pair. Thus the older three-propionyl-reaction shorthand is too narrow. The source lead still does not define the full 14-reaction route.
DRAM.dedup_scope: Inherited ignored/hidden/symlink-aware scan of 221 records, bound to the actual Calvin merge by the dedup handoff. No new exhaustive source-search or novelty claim.
